name: Pemba Skarsgard-Diallo
location: The Narrows, near Milwaukee and North Ave

physical_description.build: Lean and angular with underlying muscle density. Years of stress and irregular sleep have carved definition into his frame rather than bulk.
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back into a tight, functional undercut. Sides faded to stubble.
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm — light tan from mixed heritage, weathered by years in the Narrows
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, gaunt face, perpetual five o'clock shadow. Deep lines around the eyes and mouth suggest constant calculation. Skin shows minor scarring along the left jawline.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel burn scars running vertically down the inside of his right forearm, about 8cm long, faded to pale pink
A thin surgical scar behind his left ear, hidden unless head is tilted — suggests subcutaneous implant
Knuckle tattoos on both hands: small geometric symbols in black ink, worn but still visible
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None immediately apparent. His right hand moves with faint mechanical precision at the wrist — suggests internal servo augmentation, but easily missed. No chrome, no LEDs.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. Rarely gestures broadly. Sits with his back to walls. Moves with the patience of someone who has learned that rushing in the Narrows is fatal. Hands remain visible and still when in neutral territory.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical. Worn but well-maintained synthetic leather jacket over a muted grey thermoweave hoodie. Black cargo pants with reinforced pockets and a concealed thigh rig. Scuffed steel-toe boots. A thin chain bracelet of dull silver or recycled platinum on his left wrist — status marker among fixers. No flashy corpo logos, no gang colors. Dresses to move and to blend.
